title: The Second Part of Sit With Me
paragraphs: Its me again Christina. Using my technical skills i have came up with my own website. Praise God for that. I'm happy now that now I'm hosting my own website and also written my second blog. Sit back again and relax lets have a chat again. I hope you will find this useful. Today I wanna shower grace all over you so that you will know the heart of God and his divine plan of redemption that he has carried out through Jesus Christ. In our last #1 blog we came to know the gospel of Jesus Christ from Romans chapter 1 that is the news of Jesus Christ, how it reveals the righteousness of God, and its the power that leads people to salvation. I have also given explanation about what salvation is. All though I have elaborated about the gospel and what is it all about I have just mentioned that gospel carries power which empowers the hearer to be led to salvation. But lets see how this liberating power comes and what is this liberating power? Have you ever questioned Life? The purpose of life? Why bad and sin is rampant on earth? Why evil is lurking inside your head? Does it ever make you question your own morality?  For example you have drinking problem and you tried quitting the habit. But the more you try the harder you fell in the habit. With others may be it was drug issue, or porn. Have you felt so disgusted about the sin you are in and felt helpless that it seemed impossible for you to come out of it?

To answer this question we should go back to the origin of the humanity. YES! ADAM! Adam was created by God. He was made out of mud and when God breathed on him he became a living soul. But Adam was beguiled and so he fell. God has cursed Adam, Eve and the serpent. Adam and Eve multiplied they have filled the earth. Through this one man's sin, sin reigned on earth. On all creation. Now the wages of sin is death. So through sin death reigned on earth. When Adam fell and sinned God said

'To Adam he said, “Because you listened to your wife and ate fruit from the tree about which I commanded you, ‘You must not eat from it,’ “Cursed is the ground because of you; through painful toil you will eat food from it all the days of your life. '

Some people ask me "Is your God that offended by the man's mistake that he cursed him?" My Guy! You got it all wrong read the above verse. God is letting Adam know that because of what he did ground was cursed. You have to understand before Adam fell he is the king of the earth. God told Adam right after he became a living soul that he should 'Rule and Reign'. But when Adam fell he gave that authority to satan. Now satan became the prince of the Earth, the ruler of the Earth. Adam became the slave of sin. Now whatever you are facing because of the mistakes you did like say you committed a sin and now you are facing stagnation. All though you are the one who did that mistake but the reason for your fall is not you but its the Sin that Adam has done. You and I belong to his bloodline. Adam brought Sin into this world. Before you even sinned Sin existed in this world. So if you sinned its not because of you but because that sin was brought into your blood by Adam. You can see in the old covenant God saying that For a man's sin a curse will follow the man till the third generation. we always feel this way "Adam has commited the sin why am I still bearing those consequences, why am I cursed for his mistake? What did I do?
'For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man,

Romans 5:17
'For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, '

When God pronounced a curse or promise or even a blessing he does it to the whole mankind. Its for everyone. Its a principle. For the sake of promise he gave to Abraham even in the fury of Israel's sin,  when Moses reminded God about the promise God took a step back from killing the Isaraelites. God said he would protect Israel even though after Solomon Israel splits in to two clans. But when Saul killed Gibeonites who's fore fathers have made a covenant with Joshua, a famine was caused for breaking of the covenant in the time of David as King. So curse ruled over mankind due to Adam sin. Its like whole mankind was in Adam when he committed sin. Just like Levi was in Abraham when he tithed to Melchizedek, We were in Adam sinning. So the sin you are doing now is already committed by Adam that day. When you were in sin it was the seed of Adam that was in you that made you sin. So you have the same characteristics of that seed. The root is in the bloodline. Judgment came through transgression.

Let me make you feel better.  All these examples i have shown you is to let you know that your sin is not yours. You have inherited from Adam. Its in your blood. But what's the solution? How can I be saved from my cycle of Sin and Guilt. Now Jesus comes into the scene. Adam when he was life less and was just a pile of clay God breathed into him that's when he became alive. That's when out of no where Blood appeared in Adam's body. Since that blood was corrupted, God himself again had to come with his own flesh and with his own blood. When Mary mother of Jesus was visited by Gabriel who has delivered the news of Birth of Jesus. That through Holy spirit she will bear the child. So the same was repeated. Mary offered her egg to the holy spirit and when the spirit has entered her the egg received life. After few weeks the egg started developing blood. The blood from God himself. God had to use his own blood to redeem mankind. Science fact: that women's egg doesn't even have blood. Its when a sperm meets the egg it starts developing blood. That's why he is called Emmanuel.  He became one of us. I love this verse :
'but when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law, '

Jesus now has flesh and spirit. Now Jesus is called the last Adam. But how did he dealt with this sin. You have to remember that if you are sinning it means you are a slave to your flesh. A carnal person is the one who sins, because when adam fell he became the most carnal person on the Earth, His spirit used to dominate his body and now that his flesh is the master after the fall and he became a slave to his flesh so sin reigned on flesh. The more you sinned the more indebted you become to God and wages of sin is death. Bible says that to be carnally minded is death, but to have your mind in spirit is life. Therefore since you are a carnal person you tend to do more sin because flesh cannot empower you to be good. In addition to that we have law which is a bunch of do's and dont's. Law is perfect and good. It unveils what sin actually is and the important thing you need to know is law is spiritual. You on the other hand are carnal. Therefore knowing what is bad in sight of God has made you to covet over those bad things as you are in flesh. So you want to do good and hate bad but you are unable to do good and you dont wanna do the bad thing but some how you end doing the bad thing. It is the sin that is ruling over your flesh which is making you do it. But the consequences are on you. This is unfair!  You dont have the power to withhold yourself from doing bad. Please read Romans 7 where paul explains about this in an extraordinary way. But Thanks be to God who dealt with this problem in an unusual way. Remember how Jesus became flesh. He didnt just become flesh but on the cross he took your flesh. He said "The mankind became so indebted to sin now i will bear their sin and their death. I will become their flesh." Jesus was given unto death for the sins of mankind. Now you dont have that sinful flesh. You are not that sinful flesh. Now you are spirit. How? Because you are sold to Christ now. You became a slave to Christ. Before you belived in Christ you were a slave to Sin but now you are a bond slave to Jesus Christ. Jesus paid the debt with his body and blood in full. you are bought by Jesus' blood. Now you are free from sin and death. You are co-crucified with Christ. You are a slave to his spirit now. Your flesh is crucified and now you are dead to sin and flesh. You are a spirit. Read Romans 8:10. Now you nolonger are flesh but you are spirit. That thing that was difficult for you to do is much more easier in spirit because you have holyspirit in you. You are dead to law and sin. There is no law that you are bound to right now, but the law of spirit and life. Therefore knowing that you are spirit but not your body liberates you from sin. Now that you are Spirit you are equipped with power to defeat sin, stand against vials of the enemy, you are archon a principality, and there is resurrection powers flowing in your spirit. Now there is no need to fear about sin and falling short of expectations. you are righteous no matter what. but if you fell again in sin give no room to condemnation but get right back up by aligning yourself to being spiritual. "How can i be spiritual?" is what you can ask me. Being spiritual is having God's word in your heart and believing in it constantly so that your inner man which is your spirit become stronger and stronger. Thats how you give no place to the devil.
